title: Measured Tree improvement; Pivot and Table audit

source.method: SHA-256 of UTF-8 compact JSON object with ordinally sorted paths and SHA-256 values

cleanup.verification: Every archived regular file compared byte-for-byte via SHA-256 with its frozen disk copy before deletion; symlink destinations checked. Original source manifests retained without rewriting legacy compiler metadata.

method: Corrected paired before/after sources, each compiled as VDOM or Vapor; both controls select renderer-specific directive lifecycles; same canonical fixture and settings. See assessment method for confidence limits.

assessment.method: 64 paired trials; deterministic 10,000-resample percentile bootstrap of median paired differences; two 32-trial blocks. Diagnostic confidence, not a field guarantee.

run.method: Frozen before/after source, each compiled as VDOM and Vapor; same canonical fixture and 2,000 records; 8 warmups, 64 trials in two 32-trial blocks; rotating first variant; Chromium memory after forced GC

decision.reason: Native point estimate 0.20ms; paired median delta confidence interval crosses zero; duplicated template rejected.

isolated.name: tree-prefetch

decision.reason: Native paired CI crosses zero and first block regresses; VDOM median and native p95 worsen. Reverted candidate.

isolated.caveat: Native A/B result only. Provisional VDOM controls lacked directive adaptation; corrected combined results supersede those VDOM timings.

isolated.name: tree-shallow

decision.reason: One private derived list changed from deep ref to shallowRef. Native median 9.80 to 8.70ms; paired median delta -1.30ms, 95% bootstrap interval [-1.60, -1.10]; both blocks improve. Matched VDOM median 8.70 to 7.10ms; native and VDOM p95 improve. All 24 SSR/hydration, 12 same-compiler DOM parity, scroll and 30-cycle retention checks pass. Final application behavior gates remain required.

isolated.caveat: Native A/B result only. Provisional VDOM controls lacked directive adaptation; corrected combined results supersede those VDOM timings.

isolated.name: pivot-cells

decision.reason: Final corrected replication failed: native 15.40 to 15.50ms, paired median approximately 0, 95% interval [-0.25,+0.30]ms; neither block improves. Earlier native gains did not reproduce. Entire row-cell refactor and helper reverted to task-start bytes.

provisionalIsolatedDecision.reason: Row-owned cells share behavior with the public standalone component. Native median 16.70 to 16.05ms; paired median delta -0.55ms, 95% bootstrap interval [-0.90, -0.40]; both blocks improve; native p95 unchanged at 18.0ms. Matched VDOM 14.90 to 15.00ms with paired CI crossing zero. All 24 SSR/hydration, 12 same-compiler DOM parity, scroll and 30-cycle retention checks pass. Final application behavior gates remain required.

isolated.caveat: Native A/B result only. Provisional VDOM controls lacked directive adaptation; corrected combined results supersede those VDOM timings.

isolated.name: table-text

decision.reason: Isolated native gain did not replicate in the corrected combined run: 9.95 to 9.80ms, paired CI [-0.30,+0.10]ms, first block 10.10 to 10.40ms. Slot fast path reverted; contract tests retained.

isolated.caveat: Native A/B result only. Provisional VDOM controls lacked directive adaptation; corrected combined results supersede those VDOM timings.

isolated.name: table-keys

decision.reason: Small native gain measured, but replaced the custom path-dispatch implementation with the existing lodash property accessor to keep the change idiomatic. The simpler version must pass its own comparison.

isolated.caveat: Corrected controls; key preparation rejected on repeatability/proportionality.

isolated.name: table-key-standard

decision.reason: Aggregate native Table paired interval favors the change, but the second block is flat and the standalone native scroller result is inconclusive. Reverted to keep only clearly repeatable, proportionate improvements; no further tuning of this hypothesis.

isolated.caveat: Corrected controls; key preparation rejected on repeatability/proportionality.

profiles.method: Separate diagnostic run: 5 warmups; 20 CPU profiles per family/variant at 100us sampling; traces of 5 remounts; hidden production source maps
